_comment: Inputs used by the functional cases. EP = equivalence partition, BVA = boundary value. Boundaries marked 'from server' are read from the live configuration at run time.

FR-03_channel_display_name.valid_partition: private channel with valid name created by a team member

FR-04_search.valid_partition: existing keyword, and keyword + in:<channel> modifier
FR-04_search.invalid_partition: misspelled keyword (budget -> budhet, as in A1 QO-02)

FR-05_file_size.valid_partition: small .txt file shared with another member
FR-05_file_size.max_bytes: from server (FileSettings.MaxFileSize; set to MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB by global setup, default 1 MB = 1048576 bytes)
